UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private planner profile, editable dedication note, and default local reminder time for the owner.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dedicationText.description: Editable personal dedication shown on first open.

hasSeenDedication.description: Whether the owner has already dismissed the initial dedication screen.

defaultReminderHour.description: Default local reminder hour (0-23) for date-only items.

defaultReminderMinute.description: Default local reminder minute (0-59) for date-only items.

PlannerItem.title: PlannerItem
PlannerItem.description: A Plan, Task, or timed Event belonging strictly to one user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

completed.description: Completion state for standalone tasks or manual plan completion.

startDate.description: Date-only calendar start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dueDate.description: Date-only calendar due/deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dueTimeMinutes.description: Optional local time of day in minutes since midnight (0-1439).

startAtUtcMillis.description: UTC epoch milliseconds for timed Event start.

endAtUtcMillis.description: UTC epoch milliseconds for timed Event end.

parentPlanId.description: Optional Plan ID when a Task counts as one step in a Plan.

PlannerStep.title: PlannerStep
PlannerStep.description: A milestone belonging to a Plan or a preparation step belonging to an Event.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

completed.description: Whether this step is complete and its forget-me-not has bloomed.

dueDate.description: Optional step due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dueTimeMinutes.description: Optional step due time in minutes since midnight (0-1439).

sortOrder.description: Ordering index within the parent item.

PlannerReminder.title: PlannerReminder
PlannerReminder.description: Scheduled ordinary reminder or progress check-in occurrence for an item.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

offsetMinutes.description: Minutes before deadline or event start.

localHour.description: Preferred local hour (0-23) for date-only reminders.

localMinute.description: Preferred local minute (0-59) for date-only reminders.

scheduledAtUtcMillis.description: Computed trigger instant in UTC epoch milliseconds.

snoozedUntilUtcMillis.description: Optional snooze target in UTC epoch milliseconds for this occurrence only.

occurrenceKey.description: Stable deduplication key for this reminder occurrence.

dismissed.description: Whether the owner dismissed this inbox entry.

deliveredAtUtcMillis.description: Optional timestamp when local notification was delivered.

ClassSchedule.title: ClassSchedule
ClassSchedule.description: A customizable recurring class schedule entry with semester duration in months and optional reminder lead time.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

room.description: Optional room, building, or instructor note.

repeatMode.description: Whether class repeats on selected weekdays or a day of the month.

daysOfWeek.description: Weekday indices (0=Sun..6=Sat) when repeatMode is WEEKLY.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of month (1-31) when repeatMode is MONTHLY_DAY.

startTimeMinutes.description: Class start time in minutes since midnight (0-1439).

endTimeMinutes.description: Class end time in minutes since midnight (0-1439).

semesterStartDate.description: Semester start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

semesterMonths.description: Number of months in the semester (1-12).

notifyOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes before class start to send notification (0-10080).

colorKey.description: Soft pastel tint key for the timetable cell.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner profile and editable dedication.

/users/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Owner's private Plans, Tasks, and Events.

/users/{userId}/steps/{stepId}.description: Milestones and preparation checklist steps linked to parent items.

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Ordinary reminders and progress check-ins linked to parent items.

/users/{userId}/classSchedules/{schedule.description: Owner's customizable semester class schedule entries.
